findings.description: __aexit__ discards the real exception details and forwards None, None, None to __exit__, so an exception raised inside `async with attempt:` is recorded as a successful attempt instead of a failure.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an async retried coroutine raises inside `async with attempt:`. Mechanism: __aexit__ ignores exc_type, exc_value and traceback and calls self.__exit__(None, None, None), which takes the success path (set_result(None)), so the retry state never records the exception and the exception is not handled as a failed attempt. Impact: the retry loop never retries the failing attempt, and the error propagates straight out of the retry call while the statistics report success. Passing the received exception arguments through would fix this.
